description: Standardized metric names across all modules

stage1_eligibleFacilities.description: Number of facilities meeting eligibility criteria for the benefit

stage2_accreditedFacilities.description: Number of facilities that completed accreditation process

stage3_filingFacilities.description: Number of accredited facilities that have filed at least one claim

stage4_receivingPaymentFacilities.description: Number of facilities that have received at least one payment

accreditationRate.description: Percentage of eligible facilities that completed accreditation

filingRate.description: Percentage of accredited facilities that filed claims

paymentReceiptRate.description: Percentage of filing facilities that received payment

stage2_acceptedClaims.description: Number of claims that passed initial validation

stage3_adjudicatedClaims.description: Number of claims that completed adjudication review

stage4_approvedClaims.description: Number of claims approved for payment

stage5_paidClaims.description: Number of claims for which payment was disbursed

acceptanceRate.description: Percentage of submitted claims that passed initial validation

adjudicationRate.description: Percentage of accepted claims that completed adjudication

approvalRate.description: Percentage of adjudicated claims that were approved

paymentRate.description: Percentage of approved claims that received payment

totalBilledAmount.description: Total amount billed across all submitted claims

totalApprovedAmount.description: Total amount approved for payment across approved claims

totalDisbursedAmount.description: Total amount actually paid to facilities

averageBilledPerClaim.description: Average billed amount per submitted claim

averageApprovedPerClaim.description: Average approved amount per approved claim

averageDisbursedPerClaim.description: Average disbursed amount per paid claim

averageDaysToApproval.description: Average days from service date to approval

averageDaysToPayment.description: Average days from service date to payment disbursement

medianDaysToPayment.description: Median days from service date to payment disbursement

regionalAccreditationRate.description: Accreditation rate for a specific region

regionalFilingRate.description: Filing rate for a specific region

regionalApprovalRate.description: Approval rate for a specific region

regionalVariance.description: Difference between highest and lowest regional rates
